system.description:
People know who you are and what
you’ve done, and they treat you
differently because of it.
When you leverage your notoriety to
get what you want, you can mark a
Stress before you roll to gain a +10
bonus to the result.
Your food and drinks are always free
wherever you go, and everything else
you buy is reduced in price by one bag
of cash, credit, barter, or gold, to a
minimum of one handful.
This card doesn’t count against your
loadout’s domain card maximum of 5
and can’t be placed in your vault.
